FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 154
Committee: Military and Veterans Affairs Sponsor: Representative Ed Oliver
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/10/2025
House Bill 154 as introduced could increase or decrease the obligations of the Department of
Veterans Affairs by an undetermined amount dependent upon the difference in: (1) the salary of
the commissioner of the department set by the Alabama State Board of Veterans Affairs, as
provided by current law; and, (2) the salary set by the Governor, as provided by this bill.
This bill would also transfer certain powers and duties related to oversight of the department and
its programs from the board to the commissioner.
Finally, this bill could further increase or decrease the obligations of the department by an
undetermined amount dependent upon the difference in: (1) the per diem and travel expenses
paid to the existing 17-member board under current law; and (2) the per diem rate set by the
commissioner, as provided by this bill, and the travel expenses incurred by the 9-member
advisory board, created by this bill, to attend meetings of the board.
